Top 10 Scholarships

This post lists popular scholarships. The Post Matric Scholarship gives up to Rs. 20,000 per year to eligible students, and the income limit is Rs. 2.5 lakh per annum.

Applications usually open in July every year on the national portal, and students should keep their income certificate ready before applying.

Many students also ask whether the scholarship can be renewed; check with your institute's scholarship cell for renewal conditions each year.
